== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L266-L286
   266  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   267    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   268    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   269    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   270    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   271    is closed) -/
   272    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   273      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   274    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   275    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   276      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   277    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   278    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   279    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   280    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   281    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   282    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   283    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   284      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   285      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   286      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L208-L216
   208  inductive InstallRun (pins : List NatOpPinSet) :
   209      List Declaration → (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) →
   210      (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → Prop where
   211    | nil (p : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) :
   212        InstallRun pins [] p p
   213    | cons {pd : Declaration} {ds : List Declaration} {p p₁ p' : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck}
   214        (h : installDeclStep mode pins p pd = .ok p₁)
   215        (rest : InstallRun pins ds p₁ p') :
   216        InstallRun pins (pd :: ds) p p'

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L285-L289
   285  def GroupChecked {pins : List NatOpPinSet} {ds : List Declaration}
   286      (e : InstalledEnv mode pins ds) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
   287    match e.pend[i]? with
   288    | some pc => ∃ s', checkPending mode e.fe pc {} = .ok ((), s')
   289    | none => True

    29  def whnfCore (env : Env) (fuel depth : Nat) (e : Expr) (cheap : Bool := false) :

== ConLeche/Kernel/Exclusive.lean#L6-L42
     6  # `withExclusive`: the reference-count read behind the walk memo
     7  
     8  **What it is.**  `withExclusive a k h` runs the continuation `k` on
     9  whether the object `a` is *exclusive* — single-threaded with reference
    10  count exactly 1, so that no other reference to it exists.  In the logic
    11  it is `k false` ("not known to be exclusive", the conservative answer);
    12  in compiled code `@[implemented_by]` substitutes `k
    13  (isExclusiveUnsafe a)`, the real count read off the object header
    14  (`Init/Util.lean`, `@[extern "lean_is_exclusive_obj"]`, a BORROWED
    15  parameter; `lean_is_exclusive` in `lean.h`).  A multi-threaded object
    16  (count `< 0`) and a persistent one (count `0` — the installed
    17  environment after the driver's `Runtime.markPersistent`) answer
    18  `false`, which is the safe side.
    19  
    20  **What licenses the substitution** is the obligation
    21  
    22  ```
    23  h : k true = k false
    24  ```
    25  
    26  — the continuation's value does not depend on the answer, so the
    27  compiled program computes the very value the definition names.  A
    28  caller may use the answer to choose *how* to compute a value, never
    29  *which* value.  `Init.Util`'s `withPtrAddr` is the same arrangement
    30  (`k 0` in the model, the address in the binary, the continuation
    31  address-blind by obligation), and `Bool` being two-valued makes
    32  `k true = k false` the whole of `∀ b₁ b₂, k b₁ = k b₂`.
    33  
    34  **What it is for.**  The per-walk memo tables of the substitution walks
    35  (`ConLeche/Cached/ExprOpsC.lean`) exist for one reason: a node reached
    36  twice — a shared sub-DAG — must be rebuilt once, so that the walk is
    37  `O(DAG)` and its OUTPUT stays shared.  A node with exactly one
    38  reference cannot be reached twice, so recording it is pure loss: the
    39  key, the entry, the probe.  The official kernel's `replace_fn`
    40  (`src/kernel/replace_fn.cpp`) therefore caches a node's replacement
    41  only when `!is_likely_unshared(e)` — the same read.  The walks memoise
    42  exactly the nodes this primitive reports shared.

== ConLeche/Term/Syntax.lean#L183-L214
   183  inductive Term where
   184    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   185    | bvar (i : Nat)
   186    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   187    | sort (u : Nat)
   188    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   189    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   190    /-- application -/
   191    | app (f a : Term)
   192    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   193    | lam (ty body : Term)
   194    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   195    | pi (ty body : Term)
   196    /-- `let _ := val; body`, **without the type**: the body is under one
   197    binder, read at the value -/
   198    | letE (val body : Term)
   199    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`, **without the type**: the interpretation is
   200    `⟦eqE a b⟧ = eqv ⟦a⟧ ⟦b⟧`, so soundness never constrains the type,
   201    and a census (task #237) found no definition and no theorem in any
   202    tier reading the slot the former used to carry.  It is gone; a
   203    producer that knows the type simply drops it. -/
   204    | eqE (lhs rhs : Term)
   205    /-- First field of a pair.  Carries **only** the subject: the pair's
   206    type arguments come from the typing premise `Γ ⊢ p : Σ A B`,
   207    not from the term — see the module docstring.  Interpreted by
   208    `sfst`, i.e. literally `interp`'s clause. -/
   209    | fst (e : Term)
   210    /-- Second field of a pair; the `fst` twin, interpreted by `ssnd`. -/
   211    | snd (e : Term)
   212    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
   213    | prf
   214    deriving Repr, Inhabited

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L42-L67
    42  inductive AnnotTerm where
    43    /-- de Bruijn index -/
    44    | bvar (i : Nat)
    45    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
    46    | sort (u : Nat)
    47    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
    48    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    49    /-- application -/
    50    | app (f a : AnnotTerm)
    51    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
    52    | lam (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    53    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
    54    | pi (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    55    /-- `let _ := val; body`: the body under one binder, read at the
    56    value; no type slot, as in `Term` -/
    57    | letE (val body : AnnotTerm)
    58    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`; no annotation, and no type slot either, as in
    59    `Term` (task #237) -/
    60    | eqE (lhs rhs : AnnotTerm)
    61    /-- first field of a pair -/
    62    | fst (e : AnnotTerm)
    63    /-- second field of a pair -/
    64    | snd (e : AnnotTerm)
    65    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
    66    | prf
    67    deriving Repr, Inhabited

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L134-L145
   134  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   135    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   136    | _, .sort u => univ u
   137    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   138    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   139    | ρ, .lam A b => lamV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   140    | ρ, .pi A B => piV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   141    | ρ, .letE v b => interp (cons (interp ρ v) ρ) b
   142    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   143    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   144    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   145    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L50-L80
    50  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    51    | ρ, .pi A B =>
    52      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    53      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B) ∧
    54      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (interp V (cons x ρ) B))
    55    | ρ, .lam A b =>
    56      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    57      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    58      ∃ B : V → V,
    59        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    60        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (B x))
    61    | ρ, .app f a =>
    62      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    63      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    64        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    65        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V)) ∧
    66        (v ≠ 0 → IsTy A)
    67    | ρ, .fst e =>
    68      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    69      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    70        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    71    | ρ, .snd e =>
    72      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    73      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    74        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    75    | ρ, .eqE a b => WellDenoted ρ a ∧ WellDenoted ρ b
    76    | ρ, .letE v b => WellDenoted ρ v ∧ WellDenoted (cons (interp V ρ v) ρ) b
    77    | _, .bvar _ => True
    78    | _, .sort _ => True
    79    | _, .const _ _ => True
    80    | _, .prf => True

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L137-L324
   137  /-! ### The substitution metatheory -/
   138  
   139  /-- Truthfulness through lifting. -/
   140  theorem WellDenoted_liftN (n : Nat) :
   141      ∀ (e : AnnotTerm) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   142        WellDenoted V ρ (e.liftN n k) ↔ WellDenoted V (shiftE n k ρ) e := by
   143    intro e
   144    induction e with
   145    | bvar i =>
   146      intro k ρ
   147      simp only [AnnotTerm.liftN_bvar]
   148      split <;> simp
   149    | sort u => intro k ρ; simp
   150    | const c us => intro k ρ; simp
   151    | app f a ihf iha =>
   152      intro k ρ
   153      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf, iha,
   154        interp_liftN, interp_liftN]
   155    | lam A b ihA ihb =>
   156      intro k ρ
   157      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA, interp_liftN]
   158      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   159        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   160        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   161          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl)))
   162      · rw [ihb, cons_shiftE]
   163      · rw [interp_liftN, cons_shiftE]
   164    | pi A B ihA ihB =>
   165      intro k ρ
   166      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA, interp_liftN]
   167      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   168        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   169        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)))
   170      · rw [ihB, cons_shiftE]
   171      · rw [interp_liftN, cons_shiftE]
   172    | letE v b ihv ihb =>
   173      intro k ρ
   174      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_letE, WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_letE, ihv,
   175        interp_liftN, ihb, cons_shiftE]
   176    | eqE a b iha ihb =>
   177      intro k ρ
   178      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, iha, ihb]
   179    | fst e ihe =>
   180      intro k ρ
   181      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe,
   182        interp_liftN]
   183    | snd e ihe =>
   184      intro k ρ
   185      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe,
   186        interp_liftN]
   187    | prf => intro k ρ; simp
   188  
   189  /-- Truthfulness through instantiation. -/
   190  theorem WellDenoted_inst :
   191      ∀ (e a : AnnotTerm) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   192        WellDenoted V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a →
   193        (WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a k) ↔
   194          WellDenoted V (instE k (interp V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a) ρ) e) := by
   195    intro e
   196    induction e with
   197    | bvar i =>
   198      intro a k ρ ha
   199      show WellDenoted V ρ
   200          (if i < k then .bvar i
   201           else if i = k then AnnotTerm.liftN k a else .bvar (i - 1)) ↔ _
   202      by_cases h : i < k
   203      · simp [ite_eq_left h]
   204      · by_cases h2 : i = k
   205        · simp only [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_left h2, WellDenoted_bvar, iff_true]
   206          exact (WellDenoted_liftN V k a 0 ρ).mpr ha
   207        · simp [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h2]
   208    | sort u => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   209    | const c us => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   210    | app f b ihf ihb =>
   211      intro a k ρ ha
   212      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf a k ρ ha,
   213        ihb a k ρ ha, interp_inst, interp_inst]
   214    | lam A b ihA ihb =>
   215      intro a k ρ ha
   216      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA a k ρ ha,
   217        interp_inst]
   218      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   219        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   220        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   221          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl)))
   222      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   223          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   224        rw [ihb a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   225      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   226          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   227        rw [interp_inst, shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   228    | pi A B ihA ihB =>
   229      intro a k ρ ha
   230      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA a k ρ ha,
   231        interp_inst]
   232      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   233        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   234        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)))
   235      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   236          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   237        rw [ihB a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   238      · rw [interp_inst, shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   239    | letE v b ihv ihb =>
   240      intro a k ρ ha
   241      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_letE, WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_letE, ihv a k ρ ha,
   242        interp_inst]
   243      refine and_congr Iff.rfl ?_
   244      have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0
   245          (cons (interp V (instE k (interp V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a) ρ) v) ρ)) a := by
   246        rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   247      rw [ihb a (k + 1) _ ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   248    | eqE x y ihx ihy =>
   249      intro a k ρ ha
   250      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, ihx a k ρ ha,
   251        ihy a k ρ ha]
   252    | fst e ihe =>
   253      intro a k ρ ha
   254      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe a k ρ ha,
   255        interp_inst]
   256    | snd e ihe =>
   257      intro a k ρ ha
   258      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe a k ρ ha,
   259        interp_inst]
   260    | prf => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   261  
   262  /-- Substitution at the outermost binder — the β/ζ transport form. -/
   263  theorem WellDenoted_inst0 {e a : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   264      (ha : WellDenoted V ρ a) :
   265      WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a) ↔
   266        WellDenoted V (cons (interp V ρ a) ρ) e := by
   267    have h := WellDenoted_inst V e a 0 ρ (by rwa [shiftE_zero_zero])
   268    rwa [shiftE_zero_zero, instE_zero] at h
   269  
   270  /-- **ζ, graded**: a `let` interprets as its reduct, and with its value
   271  graded it is graded exactly when its reduct is.  Unconditional: no
   272  binder, so no regime. -/
   273  theorem interp_zeta (v b : AnnotTerm) (ρ : Nat → V) :
   274      interp V ρ (.letE v b) = interp V ρ (b.inst v) := by
   275    rw [interp_letE, interp_inst0]
   276  
   277  theorem WellDenoted_zeta {v b : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   278      (hv : WellDenoted V ρ v) :
   279      WellDenoted V ρ (.letE v b) ↔ WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst v) := by
   280    rw [WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_inst0 V hv]
   281    exact and_iff_right hv
   282  
   283  /-! ### The graded β step
   284  
   285  At a redex that is not the point, from the subject's `WellDenoted`
   286  alone: the λ is not the point (`app_pt`), so it is a graph and the
   287  slot's function space is in the graph regime; the graph fixes its
   288  domain (`piR_dom_unique`), so the argument lies in the λ's domain, and
   289  β is `app_lamV`.  At the point there is nothing to show: the claims
   290  that read this are conditional on "not the point". -/
   291  
   292  /-- The λ's own membership, read off its clause: an abstraction whose
   293  body is bounded by a family of types is a member of that family's
   294  function space. -/
   295  theorem WellDenoted_lam_mem {A b : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   296      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.lam A b)) :
   297      ∃ B : V → V, interp V ρ (.lam A b) ∈ˢ piV (interp V ρ A) B ∧
   298        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (B x)) := by
   299    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at h
   300    obtain ⟨-, -, -, B, hfib, hty⟩ := h
   301    exact ⟨B, by rw [interp_lam]; exact lamV_mem hfib hty, hty⟩
   302  
   303  /-- **The graded β step** at a redex that is not the point. -/
   304  theorem WellDenoted_beta {A b a : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   305      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a))
   306      (hne : interp V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a) ≠ pt) :
   307      interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A ∧
   308      interp V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a) = interp V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   309      WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   310    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   311    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, v', A', B', hslot, hmem, -, -⟩ := h
   312    have hlne : interp V ρ (.lam A b) ≠ pt := by
   313      intro h0; apply hne; rw [interp_app, h0, app_pt]
   314    have hv' : v' ≠ 0 := by
   315      intro h0; subst h0; exact hlne (eq_pt_of_mem_piR_zero hslot)
   316    obtain ⟨-, -, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := (WellDenoted_lam V ρ A b).mp hlam
   317    have hgraph : interp V ρ (.lam A b) = graph (fun x => interp V (cons x ρ) b) (interp V ρ A) := by
   318      rw [interp_lam] at hlne ⊢; exact lamV_eq_graph hlne
   319    have hown : interp V ρ (.lam A b) ∈ˢ piR 1 (interp V ρ A) B := by
   320      rw [hgraph, piR_pos (by decide)]; exact graph_mem_piSet hfib
   321    have hAA : interp V ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique (by decide) hv' hown hslot
   322    have haA : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A := hAA ▸ hmem
   323    refine ⟨haA, ?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)⟩
   324    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, app_lamV haA, interp_inst0]

== ConLeche/Model/Annot/EnvModel.lean#L38-L67
    38  structure EnvModel (env : Env) where
    39    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    40    wf : EnvWF env
    41    /-- the annotated valuation -/
    42    acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AnnotTerm
    43    /-- every erased leaf is closed; consumers read the `cvalE`-spelled `cval_closed` below -/
    44    cval_closedL : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    45      Term.Closed ((acval n ψ).erase)
    46    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    47    by their direct pins (V-free); consumers
    48    read the `cvalE`-spelled `basis_pinned` below -/
    49    basis_pinnedL : BasisPinnedTT env (fun n ψ => (acval n ψ).erase)
    50    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    51    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    52    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    53    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    54    shared) -/
    55    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    56    /-- every leaf is closed, as a lifting equation -/
    57    acval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (k : Nat),
    58      (acval n ψ).liftN 1 k = acval n ψ
    59    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    60    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    61      env.find? n = some ci →
    62      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    63        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    64        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    65    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    66    acval_wellDenoted : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    67      WellDenoted V ρ (acval n ψ)

== ConLeche/Model/Denotes.lean#L193-L199
   193  theorem Denotes_of_denoteMeta {acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AnnotTerm}
   194      (hcl : ∀ n ψ, Term.Closed (acval n ψ).erase) {env : Env} {φ : Name → Nat} :
   195      ∀ (d : Nat) (e : Expr) {ta : AnnotTerm},
   196        denoteMeta acval env φ d e = some ta →
   197        Expr.fvarsBelow d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   198        ∀ ρ : Nat → V,
   199          Denotes (cvalOf (V := V) acval) env φ ρ (closeN d e) (interp V ρ ta) := by

== ConLeche/Model/Claims.lean#L56-L132
    56  /-- Head normalisation, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    57  point (task #342, L9): the reduct is graded and equal where the subject
    58  is not the point. -/
    59  @[expose] def WhnfCoreClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    60      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    61    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    62      whnfCore μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    63      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    64      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    65      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
    66        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    67        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    68        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    69        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
    70        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    71            WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
    72          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    73            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    74  
    75  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    76  point (task #342, L9). -/
    77  @[expose] def WhnfClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    78      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    79    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    80      whnf μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    81      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    82      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    83      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
    84        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    85        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    86        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    87        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
    88        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    89            WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
    90          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    91            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    92  
    93  /-- Definitional equality, P currency, conditional on the point (task
    94  #342, L9): two sides that are not the point are equal.  A consumer
    95  comparing two types or two members of one type closes with
    96  `eq_of_IsTy_of_ne_pt` / `IsTy.eq_of_ne_pt`. -/
    97  @[expose] def DefEqClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    98      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    99    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   100      ConLeche.isDefEqCore μ env fuel d a b = .ok true →
   101      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   102      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
   103      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   104      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
   105      ∀ {aa ba : AnnotTerm},
   106        CtxOk m φ d Δa a →
   107        CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
   108        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
   109        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
   110        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ aa) →
   111        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ba) →
   112        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   113          interp V ρ aa ≠ pt → interp V ρ ba ≠ pt →
   114          interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
   115  
   116  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
   117  type's truthfulness — bit validity included — are *conclusions*, and
   118  the type denotes a type. -/
   119  @[expose] def InferClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   120      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   121    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   122      inferTypeCore μ env fuel d e = .ok t →
   123      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   124      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   125      ∀ {ea ta : AnnotTerm},
   126        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   127        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   128        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   129        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) ∧
   130          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedTy V ρ ta) ∧
   131          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   132            interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L325-L348
   325  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   326  
   327  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   328  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   329  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   330  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   331  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   332  readability of annotations, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   333  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   334  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   335  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   336  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   337  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   338  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   339  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   340  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   341  types are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   342  `proofFast` *reads* a head's stored data to decide "definitely a
   343  proof" — and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for
   344  every `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   345  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   346  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   347  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   348  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/

    26  theorem bridge (env : Env) :
    27      ∀ fuel : Nat,
    28        WhnfCoreBridge env fuel ∧ WhnfBridge env fuel ∧ DefEqBridge env fuel ∧

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L441-L449
   441  /-- The certified structural-`Nat` operations.  Six of them
   442  (`add sub mul pow beq ble`) carry a literal fast path; `Nat.pred` is
   443  here without one — it has no fast path (official's `reduce_nat` folds
   444  nothing unary but `Nat.succ`), but `Nat.sub`'s recurrence
   445  `sub x (succ y) = pred (sub x y)` names it, so its own recurrences
   446  must be certified for `sub`'s literal fold to be sound. -/
   447  def natOpNames : List Name :=
   448    [natPredName, natAddName, natSubName, natMulName, natPowName,
   449     natBeqName, natBleName]

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L387-L404
   387  /-! ## Structural-Nat literal acceleration
   388  
   389  The official kernel accelerates the structural `Nat` operations on
   390  literals (GMP-backed there).  Here the fast path is *certified*: an
   391  operation participates only when its defining recurrence equations
   392  hold by definitional equality — checked once, at install: `checkDecl`
   393  positively rejects a nonstandard definition under one of these names,
   394  so *presence in the store is the certificate* (no runtime flag, no
   395  re-checking; a reduction-time re-check would in fact livelock — the
   396  certification's own `pred zero` equation re-enters the fast path).
   397  
   398  The certification runs in the environment *before* the operation is
   399  stored, on the equations with the operation's self-references replaced
   400  by its (annotated) definition value (`Expr.substConst0`): running it
   401  after insertion would let the operation's own just-enabled fast path
   402  discharge its all-literal-argument equations (`pred zero ≡ zero`,
   403  `beq zero zero ≡ true`) vacuously — accepting definitions that
   404  disagree with the fast path on those points, which is unsound.  The

== ConLeche/Kernel/Checker.lean#L107-L114
   107      List (Expr × Expr) → m Bool
   108    | [] => pure true
   109    | eq :: rest => do
   110      if ← ops.isDefEq env 2 eq.1 eq.2 then
   111        certifyNatEqs ops env rest
   112      else pure false
   113  
   114  /-- The pinned defining expression of a pin-certified WF-recursive op

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L451-L466
   451  /-- The WF-recursive operations with a *pinned-declaration* certified
   452  fast path: at install, `checkDecl` compares the stream's definition
   453  against a vendored pin of the toolchain's own (helper-unfolded)
   454  definition by definitional equality, and then checks the pinned
   455  `Nat.ble`-guarded characterization certificates
   456  (`ConLeche/Kernel/NatOpPins.lean`) like theorem declarations — without
   457  installing them.  Presence in the store is therefore again the
   458  capability: a stored operation under one of these names has passed pin
   459  and certificates, or the install declined.  (The name is historic:
   460  the family started with `Nat.div`/`Nat.mod` and now covers every
   461  pin-certified WF-recursive kernel-accelerated `Nat` operation —
   462  `Nat.log2` left the list when its fast path did, official folding no
   463  unary operation but `Nat.succ`.) -/
   464  def natDivModNames : List Name :=
   465    [natDivName, natModName, natGcdName, natLandName, natLorName,
   466     natXorName, natShiftLeftName, natShiftRightName]

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L601-L615
   601  def natOpGuard (env : Env) (c : Name) : Bool :=
   602    natLitSupported env &&
   603    (natOpDeps c).all (fun n => match env.find? n with
   604      | some (.defnInfo cv _ _) => cv.levelParams.isEmpty
   605      | _ => false) &&
   606    (if c = natBeqName || c = natBleName || natDivModNames.contains c then
   607      (match env.find? boolTrueName with
   608        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   609            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   610        | none => false) &&
   611      (match env.find? boolFalseName with
   612        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   613            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   614        | none => false)
   615     else true)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L156
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
   134  
   135  namespace SetTheory
   136  
   137  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ∈ˢ " => Mem
   138  
   139  variable {V : Type u} [SetTheory V]
   140  
   141  /-- Subset, from membership. -/
   142  protected def Subset (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ˢ x → z ∈ˢ y
   143  
   144  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ⊆ˢ " => SetTheory.Subset
   145  
   146  theorem Subset.refl (x : V) : x ⊆ˢ x := fun _ hz => hz
   147  
   148  theorem Subset.trans {x y z : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ z) : x ⊆ˢ z :=
   149    fun w hw => h₂ w (h₁ w hw)
   150  
   151  theorem Subset.antisymm {x y : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ x) : x = y :=
   152    ext fun z => ⟨h₁ z, h₂ z⟩
   153  
   154  theorem mem_power_iff_subset {z x : V} : z ∈ˢ power x ↔ z ⊆ˢ x := mem_power
   155  
   156  end SetTheory

    89  def IsTGUniverse {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop) (u : V) : Prop :=

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L9-L38
     9  /-!
    10  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    11  
    12  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed rather than
    13  declined:
    14  
    15  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    16    installed as an *opaque* (stored `axiomInfo`, exactly like a checked
    17    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    18    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    19    interpretation.
    20  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    21    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    22    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at install their stored values are
    23    pinned against the identity function
    24    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, hand-pinned since task #273 —
    25    every toolchain's definition after zeta) by definitional equality —
    26    the task-#47 pattern: drift declines, never silently.
    27  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    28    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    29    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    30    definitional-equality certificate at the operation's own install,
    31    `checkReducePin`; the axiom's install checks `ofReduceAxOk`),
    32    `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    33    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    34    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    35  
    36  `sorryAx` remains the only axiom tolerated as a *declaration*: its
    37  record installs nothing and any use of it declines
    38  (`sorryAxName`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Basis/Names.lean`).

>>> README.md

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L266-L286
   266  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   267    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   268    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   269    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   270    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   271    is closed) -/
   272    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   273      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   274    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   275    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   276      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   277    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   278    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   279    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   280    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   281    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   282    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   283    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   284      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   285      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   286      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L133
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
